about: Hand-curated core of the eval corpus: 24 windows written to read like real Deepgram output (fillers, mis-heard names, cut-off sentences, crosstalk, diarization label churn). generate.py merges these with the seeded generated windows into windows.json. Edit here, then run `uv run python -m tests.evalkit.generate`.
